items.question: Is there a cost to join?
items.body: Joining the Air Cadets is **free**. Your uniform is provided at no charge. There may be small costs for some activities (such as camps), but we work hard to ensure cost is never a barrier to participation, and bursaries are available.

items.question: Do I need any prior experience?
items.body: No experience is needed at all. Everything is taught from scratch. All you need is enthusiasm and a willingness to try new things.

items.question: What uniform will I wear?
items.body: Air Cadets wear the RAF-style blue uniform, including a wedge cap and boots. Full uniform is issued when you join and is yours to keep as long as you are a member.

items.question: Will I have to commit to every parade night?
items.body: We ask cadets to attend as regularly as possible, ideally every Tuesday evening. We understand school and family commitments come first, and our staff are always happy to discuss attendance.

items.question: What about safeguarding?
items.body: The welfare and safety of our cadets is our highest priority. All staff hold current DBS clearance, and the RAFAC has a comprehensive safeguarding policy. More information is available from the [RAFAC website](https://www.raf.mod.uk/aircadets/).
